description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to assist the Government to re-establish basic systems for public financial management.

The objective of the Public Sector Strengthening Project for Guinea-Bissau is to assist the Government to re-establish basic systems for public financial management. There are three components to the project, the first component being performance, control and transparency of the public revenues. This component will support the Recipient is to progressively improve its technical capacity to handle revenue processes through adequate procedural and control systems to increase tax and customs revenue collection, as well as the efficiency, effectiveness and transparency of revenue administration. This component includes three sub-components: technical assistance to tax collection; technical assistance to customs administration; and treasury single account. Finally, the second component is the expenditure control, procurement, accounting and reporting. This component will support the recipient to strengthen controls needed for fiscal discipline and promote transparency and accountability in public expenditures. Finally, the third component is the public financial management reform coordination and project management. This component will support the recipient to implement a mechanism for a structured approach to public financial management reform and institutional capacity strengthening.

title.narrative: Quarterly then monthly budget execution statements are published out of SIGFIP (Months, Custom)

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Indicator partially achieved.</strong> Budget execution reporting is prepared every 8 months instead of every six months as planned for the end target</p>

title.narrative: Increased tax and customs revenue by 15%

comment.narrative:
<p><strong>Indicator achieved.</strong></p>
<p>During the restructuring in 2018, this indicator was upgraded from IRI to become a PDO indicator with some adjustments. The revenue increase was lowered to 15% instead of the original 30%. Moreover, the baseline (previously 38.16) and end target (previously 49.66) were also modified. </p>

title.narrative: Increase in tax and customs audits and inspections

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Indicator partially achieved.</strong> Audits have gone up from 43 at project start to 150, so the target of 280 was partially met. On the other hand, 22 inspections were carried out compared to 4 at the start of the project against an objective of 10.</p>

title.narrative: Number of tax payers (number of NIFs issued)
Number of Steps for import and export

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Indicator partially achieved</strong>. The number of steps for importing and exporting goods were reduced from 26 to 9 steps by the end of the project against the target of 6 steps.</p>
<p><strong>Indicator partially achieved</strong>. Customs declarations through the system reached 98% utilization rate against a target of 100%</p>

<p><strong>Indicator partially achieved: </strong>external debt payment delay was reduced from 7 to 3 months at the end of the project. However, the target of 1 month delay was not reached because of cash flow difficulties</p>
<p>Unit of measure is meant to be 'months' instead of 'days'. This was not addressed after the first restructuring.  </p>

title.narrative: Dwell-time for imported and exported goods

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Indicator achieved. </strong>Processing time for import and export files was reduced from 90 to 6 days, against a target of 45 days.</p>

title.narrative: Database with reference prices for high volume import/export products

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Indicator achieved</strong>. The project enabled the establishment of a database with reference prices for large volume import / export products</p>
